Foundational VC for AI

Icon Ventures is an early -stage venture capital fund based in Palo Alto, CA. We partner with entrepreneurs building AI-native and AI-powered companies. Our expertise, formed over a long history of best-in-class venture investing, supports founders as they build the next generation of companies that change the world.
